title: Strong Ill-Posedness in critical and subcritical regimes for the Hunter-Saxton equation
summary: We study the Hunter--Saxton equation on the real line and its global dissipative solution in the energy space $ L^\infty(\mathbb R)\cap \dot H^1(\mathbb R). $ We prove strong ill-posedness through instantaneous failure of Sobolev regularity at and below the Lipschitz threshold. More precisely, for every $s\in(1,\nicefrac32]$, we construct $ u_0\in L^\infty(\mathbb R)\cap\dot H^1(\mathbb R)\cap\dot H^s(\mathbb R) $ whose unique global dissipative solution satisfies $u\notin C([0,T]; \dot H^s (\mathbb R))$, for every $T>0$.
